title: Ays
tagline: Effortlessly manage your funds, spending, saving, and investments all in one place with Ays.
description:
Ays is created to eliminate the barriers and friction that people face when wanting to interact with crypto and web3 from the financial side. Ays is a platform that integrates both budget management and the option to save and invest in Uniswap positions, stocks, or perpetuals.

Additionally, Ays is built with cutting-edge technology using Next.js 16, React.js 19, Node.js 22.17, and many more technologies.
how_its_made: This project uses Privy technology to provide embedded wallets to users and eliminate the onboarding barrier. Additionally, it offers gasless options for onchain saving actions (staking) and investing in stocks and other assets using Uniswap pools configured 100% for this purpose, and connecting to data verified by the Pyth protocol for stock acquisition.
